result.rationale: The diff adds an unconditional fetch to https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token followed by a prisma.credential.update inside the service constructor logic (SalesforceCalendarService), with no expiry check on the existing token before refreshing. This is accurately described: every connection build triggers an OAuth round-trip and DB write even when the access token is still valid. It is a substantive, specific performance/architecture concern grounded in the diff (e.g. the newly added `const response = await fetch(...)` block with no validity check), but not a correctness defect si
